resources.string: Please read this carefully before using SONIC REMOTE.

SONIC REMOTE lets one person (the Controller) ask another person (the Agent) for remote support. Nothing starts unless the Agent explicitly approves it. The Agent\'s phone shows Android\'s own screen-sharing prompt and a visible notification for as long as the screen is shared.
Only use SONIC REMOTE with the knowledge and permission of the owner of the device. Using it to watch, record, or access someone\'s phone without their clear consent is prohibited and may be a crime.

You alone are responsible for how you use the app, for the people you connect with, and for everything visible on your screen while sharing (messages, passwords, banking details, private photos). Do not share your screen while sensitive information is visible unless you fully trust the other person.

SONIC REMOTE is provided as is, without warranties of any kind. To the maximum extent permitted by law, SONICTEAM is not responsible or liable for any loss, damage, data exposure, financial loss, device problem, or misuse arising from the use of the app, from the actions of the other person in a session, or from service interruptions.
Do not use the app for fraud, scams, stalking, harassment, unauthorized access, or any illegal activity. SONICTEAM may suspend accounts that abuse the service.

To run the service we process your account email, your device name, and session records (who connected, when, and how it ended) in an audit log. Screen video travels directly between the two phones, or through a relay that cannot read it, and SONIC REMOTE does not record it.
You can stop sharing at any time with the Stop button or the notification action, end a session, or sign out whenever you want.
These terms may change. If they do, you will be asked to accept the new version.
I have read and I agree to these terms. I understand that SONICTEAM is not responsible for how I use the app.
